scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The interpretation of GZMB, GNLY, NKG7, FGFBP2, and CCL5 as markers of cytotoxic differentiation and the association of CD45RA with TEMRA cells are biologically defensible. However, the stated naive-T-cell context and possible NK or other lineage contamination make the specific TEMRA assignment less secure.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: GZMB, GNLY, NKG7, FGFBP2, and CCL5 were coherently integrated as indicators of a cytotoxic differentiation state associated with CD45RA re-expression. No molecular transition connecting any focus feature to PTPRC isoform regulation or CD45RA abundance was explained. The no-explicit-focus-to-target-mechanism ceiling of 3 was applied.
